examples.code:
# Soften the alpha edge from the currently selected matte node.
matte = nuke.selectedNode()

soft_matte = nuke.nodes.Blur(name="soften_matte_edge")
soft_matte.setInput(0, matte)
soft_matte["label"].setValue("Soften matte edge")

# Affect only alpha, preserving the source RGB channels.
soft_matte["channels"].setValue("alpha")
soft_matte["filter"].setValue("gaussian")

# A small blur removes hard roto/key edges without noticeably spreading the matte.
soft_matte["size"].setValue(2.0)

# Keep the result at full strength; adjust this to compare against the hard matte.
soft_matte["mix"].setValue(1.0)
examples.title: Soften the edge of an alpha matte
